source: Tripadvisor – Nor Nou Kaibae Hut Speed Boat (d11913596), read 2026-09-18. Rating 4.1/5 from 36 reviews. Quoted as written; newest first.

reviews.name: TonyIR2017
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Couldn't fault their entire Service. Great communication beforehand, ontime service from Koh Chang to Koh Mak and back with drop off at hotel. Overall they were great!

reviews.name: dirrtydancer
reviews.title: Excellent speedboat transfer between the islands
reviews.text: We booked 2 transfers recently, the first from Koh Kood to Koh Mak and the second from Koh Mak to Koh Chang. I initially had difficulty as I missed a letter out of my email address but they sought me out and sent me a PM via Facebook messenger – great customer service and very efficient! Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend and would definitely use again.

reviews.name: Jeremy MT
reviews.title: Brilliant afternoon of snorkeling!
reviews.text: We took a private speedboat from Koh Chang to four small islands - Koh Manok, Koh Pli, Koh Yuak and Koh Rom. Excellent guide who looked after us well and showed us the reefs. Koh Yuak has a beautiful white sand beach to relax on and swim and snorkel from!

reviews.name: Kim L
reviews.title: a great day snorkling
reviews.text: 5 island tour on this small speed boat for 1000bht was great. we stoped at every island for around 1 hour snorkling. amazing fish and rocks coral. the staff were great. could not fault the trip.

reviews.name: axels
reviews.title: A beautiful half day out for sightseeing different islands & snorkelling
reviews.text: Pick up in the resort. After 10 min. new fantastic powerful and very clean speed boats have been waiting for us. We went to beautiful different islands with snorkelling stops. On board too, a great friendly staff and very helpful with the snorkel equipment and lunch. It was a tasty and rich lunch with chicken rice and fresh fruits - very good.

reviews.name: davewebb1963
reviews.title: Good value, great fun
reviews.text: Great half day out. Excellent service, brilliant crew, loads of lovely coral and fish everywhere. Best snorkeling we have seen in Thailand.

reviews.name: Patry9393
reviews.title: Amazing half day
reviews.text: We went on a half day (10-3) snorkelling tour with Kai Bae speed boat and it was amazing. Highly recommended. The first two islands had lovely snorkelling spots, the third one was a lovely beach in the middle of nowhere where we had lunch provided by Kai Bae hut speed boat and then we went to another island where we did some more snorkelling and this was definitely the best one.

reviews.name: Pascal D
reviews.title: The best company in the island
reviews.text: The best company in the island to go in all the island around Koh Chang. Fast and professional with all security.
